accounting.dividends: entitlement to shares held before ex-date; retained after selling at ex-date open; reinvested at that session close in current portfolio asset; exit-open receivable added to terminal value
accounting.entry_exdate: new purchase does not receive that day's distribution
accounting.fund_fees: already embedded in ETF market performance; do not subtract a second annual expense ratio
accounting.payment_dates: unknown; ex-date reinvestment is an economic convention, not proved executable cash availability
accounting.prices: audited canonical UNADJUSTED economic units; no Adj Close
accounting.splits: ordinary verified split changes held share count before ex-date distribution/trade; future split proof is admin only
accounting.switch_day_dividend: kept as receivable until close, not available to buy the new asset at open
accounting.tax_fx: no taxes or FX; USD instruments only

cash_interval_diagnostics.aggregation: counts and descriptive mean relative-return gaps; intervals/horizons overlap, not independent events
cash_interval_diagnostics.avoided_loss: during each BIL interval, gross SPY return <0 AND BIL return > SPY return
cash_interval_diagnostics.missed_rally: during each BIL interval, gross SPY matched-open economic return > gross BIL matched-open economic return

costs.formula: buy shares=free_cash/(open*(1+leg_cost)); sale cash=shares*open*(1-leg_cost); every switch pays both legs
costs.gross: zero trading costs only; embedded fund expense remains

execution.entry: first common observed SPY/BIL session OPEN strictly after annual cutoff
execution.exit: OPEN after N complete common observed sessions, same for every benchmark
execution.holdings: 100pct SPY or 100pct BIL, unlevered; no discretionary override
execution.switch: first common observed session OPEN strictly after Friday review

fixed_mix.drawdown: calculated from summed daily wealth path, never average the two drawdowns
fixed_mix.purpose: negative control for merely reducing equity exposure, no optimized weight
fixed_mix.wealth: 0.5*same-timing SPY wealth + 0.5*same-timing BIL wealth; each component pays identical entry/exit leg cost

limitations: BIL is a traded short Treasury ETF, not risk-free cash; bid-ask, premium/discount and fund risks remain
Current provider historical vintages can be corrected; archived quote vintages unavailable
Daily OHLC/normal-session clocks cannot verify halts, half days, intraday ordering or execution slippage
Provider dividend amounts not all independently reconciled; economic ex-date reinvestment only
Fixed 50bp primary and 10bp sensitivity are assumptions, not estimated historical costs
Annual and 24m horizon observations overlap; report date clusters rather than independent-bet claims
Rule designed in 2026 with historical prior knowledge; no causal evidence, strategy optimization or robust-pattern claim
Do not modify or reinterpret original 24 Stage A predictions or original zero-cash scoring
design.missingness: keep each annual-cutoff/horizon record; PENDING_HORIZON or UNRESOLVED_DATA, never replace with 0

review.conservative_vendor_lag: preserved; Friday close normally becomes available Saturday 00:00 America/New_York, so Friday UTC review can use Thursday close

signal.rule: SPY past known-action economic wealth ratios BOTH > 0 => SPY; otherwise BIL
